sections.text:
-Target: all allies. Reduces Ability cooldown times (except for certain Abilities) by 20% for 50 seconds.
Cooldown reduction effect boosted by 2% for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 220. Success value 70. 3x magic damage (Light).
-Target: all allies. Reduces physical/magic damage taken to 0 (1 time).
[Unison Effect Boost] Increases the Ability Power of the 220-Ability-Power attack that deals magic light damage 3 times at success of 70 points by 50.
[Additional Unison Effect] Increases the Cost recovery speed of all allies for 50 seconds.
